intro: Perfect for compact spaces, the Esca single bed blends sleek style with practical functionality. Its durable frame and built-in storage make urban living effortless and elegant.

features.title: Stylish and sleek—designed to impress
features.text: Clean lines and a minimalist black finish make the bed a stylish addition to any room, blending seamlessly into modern interiors with ease.

features.title: Durable metal frame for longevity
features.text: Built with a strong metal frame, this bed offers reliable support and durability, ensuring it withstands daily use while maintaining its sleek appearance.

features.title: Compact yet full of possibilities
features.text: Perfect for small rooms or guest areas, its streamlined design optimises space without compromising on comfort, fitting effortlessly into any corner.

features.title: Ample storage space underneath
features.text: The spacious under-bed area keeps essentials neatly tucked away, helping you maintain a clutter-free, organised home.

features.title: Easy-to-clean ground clearance
features.text: Elevated for convenience, the bed's ground clearance allows for quick and hassle-free cleaning underneath, ensuring a tidy and hygienic space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
